summary: NexGen Energy Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on May 20, 2026, announcing the appointment of Ryan Podrasky as Chief Financial Officer, effective May 25, 2026, succeeding Benjamin Salter, who is stepping down as CFO but remaining as an advisor for transition. No financial terms, board recommendation, or advisor are mentioned. This is a management change event triggered by a CFO departure and replacement. The filing is a foreign private issuer report under Rule 13a-16. Watch for operational continuity and any future strategic impacts.
